class.name: AuthentikSession
class.brief_description: Represents an authenticated OpenID Connect / Authentik user session.
class.description: [AuthentikSession] encapsulates OAuth 2.0 tokens ([member access_token], [member id_token], [member refresh_token]), decoded OIDC identity properties ([member subject], [member display_name], [member username], [member email]), and Authentik RBAC claims ([member groups], [member entitlements]). String conversion and [method to_summary_dictionary] intentionally omit raw token values so sessions can be logged safely without leaking credentials.

method.name: get_authorization_header
method.description: Returns a formatted HTTP [code]Authorization[/code] header string (for example [code]"Bearer <token>"[/code]).

method.name: get_bearer_token
method.description: Returns the JWT bearer token preferred for backend API authorization (returning [member access_token] when it is a JWT, or [member id_token] when the access token is opaque).

method.name: get_claim
method.description: Returns the claim named [param key] from [member claims], or [param default] if absent.

method.name: get_seconds_until_expiry
method.description: Returns the remaining lifetime of the access token in seconds relative to current UTC system time.

method.name: has_all_groups
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the user belongs to every group listed in [param groups].

method.name: has_any_group
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the user belongs to at least one group listed in [param groups].

method.name: has_refresh_token
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a non-empty refresh token is available.

method.name: is_expired
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the session has expired (or will expire within [param leeway_sec] seconds).

method.name: to_summary_dictionary
method.description: Returns a dictionary of non-sensitive user metadata (subject, display name, username, email, groups, entitlements, expiry) safe for UI display or logging.

members.member: Merged dictionary of decoded OIDC token and UserInfo claims.
OAuth 2.0 client ID associated with this session.
Human-readable display name from the [code]name[/code] claim (falling back to username or email).
User email address from the [code]email[/code] claim.
Whether the user's email address has been verified by the identity provider.
Authentik application entitlements granted to the user.
Unix UTC timestamp (seconds) when the access token expires.
Group names from the OIDC [code]groups[/code] claim.
Raw OpenID Connect JWT ID token.
Normalized OIDC issuer URL that issued this session.
OAuth 2.0 refresh token, when [code]offline_access[/code] scope was granted.
Space-separated scopes granted for this session.
